intuition: The minimum path from each cell is its value plus the cheaper reachable child below.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every top-to-bottom left-or-right path and track its sum.

optimal.approach: Use a one-dimensional bottom-up DP array and overwrite each parent with its minimum child cost.

edge_cases: A one-row triangle returns its only value.
Negative values are valid and may appear anywhere.
The array is updated bottom-up so both child states are still available.
